description: You are a financial analyst performing due diligence on three major tech companies. Use the SEC EDGAR full-text search system (https://efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index?q=%22risk+factors%22&dateRange=custom&startdt=2024-01-01&enddt=2024-12-31&forms=10-K) or the EDGAR company search to locate and review the most recent 10-K annual report filings for Microsoft Corporation (CIK 0000789019), Apple Inc. (CIK 0000320193), and Alphabet Inc. (CIK 0001652044). For each company, find the 10-K filing for fiscal year 2023 or 2024, navigate to the filing index, and record: (1) the exact filing date, (2) the total number of risk factors listed in Item 1A, and (3) the company's reported total revenue (in billions USD) for the most recent fiscal year. Save your findings as a JSON file at ~/Documents/edgar_analysis.json with keys 'microsoft', 'apple', and 'alphabet', each containing 'filing_date', 'risk_factor_count', and 'revenue_billions'. Also bookmark the EDGAR filing index page for each company in a Firefox bookmark folder named 'SEC EDGAR Research'.
